strokeOrder: begin at the upper tip and descend through the short stroke
without lifting, sweep left through the lower curve

strokeOrderSource.citation: Persian Online, How to Write Persian Characters, ر demonstration at 01:10–01:12 (Liberal Arts Instructional Technology Services, Univ. of Texas at Austin)
strokeOrderSource.variation: The cited freehand lesson demonstrates isolated ر as one continuous Naskh motion: it begins at the upper tip, descends through the short stroke, and sweeps left through the lower curve without lifting. This non-connector does not join to a following letter; the learner path fits the vendored Noto Naskh outline and records Persian-scoped provenance rather than borrowing the separate Arabic or Urdu ر sources for the same Unicode glyph.

notes: Does not join to the following letter.
